description.message: Remove chosen sites and words from your browsing history. Works while you browse, at browser close, or at the next start.

layoutTitle.message: Switch between the compact popup and the classic one

optSub.message: Tell it what to forget. Rules sync between your computers, everything else stays on this device.

optLockedBody.message: Your list is hidden until you unlock it below. Wiping carries on.

optModeRealtimeHint.message: It cleans as you go, so nothing is ever left waiting around.

optModeOnCloseHint.message: Quiet while you surf. It cleans when you close the browser, or the next time you open it if that moment is missed.

optModeStartupHint.message: One clean up each time you open the browser.

optKeepOnly.message: Keep only the sites I list, wipe everything else

optRulesEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Add a site, a word, or a pattern above.

optTryUrl.message: Try a URL against your rules

optClearingHint.message: Pick one, or build your own. The history wipe above is separate and never turns off.

optPresetOffSub.message: My history only, following my rules.

optPresetLightSub.message: History, plus the saved page files that make sites open fast.

optPresetStandardSub.message: The same, plus cookies, which is what makes sites remember you.

optPresetNuclearSub.message: Everything Chrome lets a cleaner touch, all history included. Passwords are never touched.

optClearingNote.message: No count is possible: Chrome does not report what it cleared. Cookies go for the whole site, so logins there end. Download history is the list, not the files. Passwords are not included, Chrome dropped that in 144.

optCookiesOnTabClose.message: Clear a site's cookies when I close its tab

optCookieKeepLabel.message: Keep these signed in, one per line

optLockEnable.message: Ask for a PIN before showing or editing my list

optLockRecoverBtn.message: Remove the PIN and wipe my list

optLockNote.message: Turning the lock off needs the PIN. So does the right-click menu that adds a site: while the lock is on, that menu only sends a notification.

optWipeAll.message: Wipe all history, not just my rules

optWipeAllHint.message: Your list stops mattering: every trigger clears the whole history database. The list stays put and applies again the moment this is off.

optLimitsBanner.message: Chrome has no shutdown hook, so "when the browser closes" runs at close when it can and at the next launch otherwise. A deleted entry can still show in the address-bar suggestions, which live in a store no extension can reach. Cookies and cache can be cleared per site, history and form text cannot.

statusKeep.message: Wiping all but your keep list

wipeAllOn.message: Wipe-all is ON: your entire history goes, not just your rules.

keepOn.message: Everything not on your list is wiped.

modeInstantArmed.message: Every visit is erased the moment it happens.

modeClose.message: Matches go when you close the browser.

modeCloseArmed.message: Everything goes when you close the browser.

modeStart.message: Matches go at the start of your next session.

modeStartArmed.message: Everything goes at the start of your next session.

keepInstant.message: Every other site is erased as you visit it.

keepClose.message: Everything else goes when you close the browser.

keepStart.message: Everything else goes at your next start.

stateKeep.message: Active: wiping all but your keep list
